Press a shortcut, drag a box, and the recording starts. Click Stop and the video's path is on your clipboard, ready to paste into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any other agent.

**Download:** `Rec_<version>_aarch64.dmg` below (macOS 14 or newer, Apple Silicon).

**First launch:** Rec isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS says it "could not verify" the app. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. You only do this once; later updates install from inside Rec.

Everything stays on your computer: no account, no uploads, no analytics.
